verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 SXM is a data-center GPU, not a hosted service, so choosing a storage region or data residency is the wrong axis for this kind of product. Where data lives depends on the operator who deploys the hardware, not on a feature the GPU ships. Confidential Computing support and the separate Brev cloud service are adjacent or different products and do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
